name: unzip_file
description: DAG 1: extract CSVs from a ZIP onto the worker filesystem

name: prepare_csv_fanout
description: DAG 1: build the dynamicTasks / dynamicTasksInput pair for FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC

name: load_csv_to_postgres
description: DAG 1: COPY one CSV into its own table

name: run_sql_transform
description: DAG 1: JOIN the loaded tables into combined_report

name: convert_to_parquet
description: DAG 1: export combined_report to Parquet

name: submit_async_fetch
description: DAG 2: register the async fetch + the conductor resume handle

name: wait_for_fetch_callback
description: DAG 2: the WAIT task the callback service completes. 60s per the spec; on timeout the workflow is failed, which is the honest outcome for 'the callback never arrived'.

name: process_fetch_result
description: DAG 2: normalise the callback payload into {items:[...]}

name: prepare_detail_fanout
description: DAG 2: build the dynamic fork payload for the per-item detail fetches

name: fetch_item_detail
description: DAG 2: fetch one item's detail URL. concurrentExecLimit is the spec's max-concurrency-20 cap, enforced engine-side across ALL running workflows -- not per run.

name: combine_results
description: DAG 2: merge detail responses into a summary with success/failure counts

name: validate_payment
description: DAG 3: account/balance/fraud/idempotency checks

name: process_payment
description: DAG 3: flaky gateway call. EXPONENTIAL_BACKOFF from 2s over 4 attempts; PaymentDeclined bypasses all of it by raising NonRetryableException, which the SDK maps to FAILED_WITH_TERMINAL_ERROR.

name: update_payment_database
description: DAG 3: idempotent debit/credit + transaction record

name: send_payment_notification
description: DAG 3: best-effort receipt. Marked optional in the workflow so failure degrades gracefully.

name: handle_payment_failure
description: DAG 3: record the failed transaction and notify

name: validate_order
description: DAG 4: SKU existence, customer status, total_amount. No mutation, so no compensation.

name: reserve_inventory
description: DAG 4: atomically decrement available_quantity + create reservation rows

name: request_manager_approval
description: DAG 4: record the approval row and register the resume handle with the approval service

name: wait_for_approval
description: DAG 4: the WAIT task the approval service completes. 120s for automated testing (72h conceptually); TIME_OUT_WF makes the timeout fail the sub-workflow, which is what routes it into the saga.

name: record_approval_decision
description: DAG 4: persist the manager's decision to approval_requests

name: call_shipping_api
description: DAG 4: flaky shipping API, 3 retries + exponential backoff. InvalidAddress is non-retriable via NonRetryableException.

name: update_order_status
description: DAG 4: mark the order shipped with tracking info

name: send_order_notification
description: DAG 4: best-effort customer notification; optional in the workflow

name: release_inventory
description: DAG 4 saga: reverse the reservation. Idempotent -- a second call is a no-op.

name: update_order_cancelled
description: DAG 4 saga: set the order to cancelled/failed with a reason

name: send_cancellation_notification
description: DAG 4 saga: best-effort cancellation notice; optional in the workflow

name: compensation_failed_dead_letter
description: DAG 4 saga: terminal dead-letter when compensation itself fails after retries. Never retried -- it exists to be seen by a human.
